# aisearchmastery.com

> AI Search Mastery helps solopreneurs and small businesses become visible to AI search engines. Two tools: AImpactScanner (diagnoses AI visibility) and LLM.txt Mastery (fixes it). Built on the open MASTERY-AI Framework v3.1.1 with 8 pillars and 27 factors. From $9.95/month vs $129+ for enterprise alternatives.

## The Problem We Solve

93% of queries in Google's AI Mode never reach a website. When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity for a recommendation in your space, you either show up or you don't. There's no page 2. Most small businesses are invisible to AI search and don't know it.

## Our Tools

### AImpactScanner
Free AI visibility scanner. 27-factor analysis in 60 seconds. Shows exactly how AI search engines see your site with a prioritised action plan.
- URL: https://aimpactscanner.com

### LLM.txt Mastery
Generates and validates llms.txt files. The file that tells AI models how to read your site. Think robots.txt for the AI era.
- URL: https://llmtxtmastery.com
- Validator: https://llmtxtmastery.com/validator

## Who We Serve

- Solopreneurs with valuable expertise who are invisible to AI
- Freelancers and consultants losing business to AI-visible competitors
- Small agencies wanting to offer AI visibility services to clients
- Anyone spending $129+/month on enterprise AI SEO tools who wants a 92% cheaper alternative

## Framework

The MASTERY-AI Framework v3.1.1 is our open methodology for measuring AI visibility. 8 pillars, 27 factors, used by both tools.
